headline: FMS strength lifts earnings despite SCS softness
summary_short: Ryder's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 5.2% y/y to $3,354M and diluted EPS climbed 8.3% to $3.39, as FMS earnings growth offset weaker SCS results and a $10M intangible impairment.
summary_long: Revenue rose 5.2% y/y to $3,354M, driven by higher SCS and FMS revenue including fuel pass-through; core operating revenue (ex-fuel) grew 3% on SCS contractual gains. GAAP EBT (continuing ops) was roughly flat at $185M as FMS EBT growth (+20%) offset a 7% SCS EBT decline, a $10M non-cash intangible impairment, and an $8M Canadian pension settlement charge. Net income rose to $133M and diluted EPS to $3.39 (+8.3% y/y), aided by share repurchases ($99M this quarter). Free cash flow rose to $684M YTD on lower capex ($812M YTD vs $1,192M). The board raised the quarterly dividend 11% to $1.01/share. No forward guidance was given in this filing.
